newsitem.title: USA: Reuters 30-day muni supply falls to $4.519 bln.
newsitem.headline: Reuters 30-day muni supply falls to $4.519 bln.

text.p: Reuters said Wednesday it calculated its 30-day visible supply of upcoming municipal bond sales at $4.519 billion, down $445 million from Tuesday.
Negotiated sales total $2.197 billion in 49 issues and competitive bond sales total $2.322 billion in 190 issues.
Reuters visible supply counts all deals underwriters have either scheduled for sale in the next 30 business days, or have said they tentatively plan to price during the period.

The supply figure is based on sales data compiled by Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group and uses municipal securities with maturities 13 months or longer. All bond deals $1 million or larger are included.
